GHSA-2xxx-fhc8-9qvq.basis: GHSA-4r2f-6fm9-2qgh is a GitHub-withdrawn duplicate advisory: its own text says it duplicates GHSA-2xxx-fhc8-9qvq and is kept only to preserve external references. The canonical advisory is already a Ground Truth row on this same v2.2.0 snapshot (vulnerability GHSA-2xxx-fhc8-9qvq, alias CVE-2017-20166, anchor lib/ecto/repo/queryable.ex:351-352, fix db55b0cba652, range = 2.2.0 fixed in 2.2.1). The withdrawn advisory adds no distinct root cause, so the candidate resolves as a duplicate.

CVE-2026-32687.basis: Channel-name SQL injection in Postgrex.Notifications.listen/3. The GitHub advisory filed in the elixir-ecto/ecto repository names package `postgrex` (range > 0.16.0, fixed 0.22.2) and the NVD record's only CPE is cpe:2.3:a:elixir-ecto:postgrex. The frozen ecto v2.2.0 tree contains no Postgrex.Notifications module (no "Notifications" match under lib/ or test/) and its optional postgrex requirement is "~> 0.13.0" (mix.exs:47), below the first affected postgrex release. No ecto source component is affected; the candidate entered the ecto queue because the advisory was published under the ecto repository.

CVE-2026-58225.basis: SQL injection through an unescaped dollar-quote ($$) in the reconnect DO block. The advisory filed in elixir-ecto/ecto names package `postgrex` (range >= 0.16.0, fixed 0.22.3); NVD describes it as "SQL Injection vulnerability in elixir-ecto postgrex". The frozen ecto v2.2.0 tree has no reconnect/notification code and its optional postgrex requirement is "~> 0.13.0" (mix.exs:47). No ecto source component is affected.

CVE-2026-66838.basis: SQL injection through the :comment option of Postgrex.stream/4. The advisory filed in elixir-ecto/ecto names package `postgrex` (range >= 0.19.3 and < 0.22.4) and NVD's only CPE is cpe:2.3:a:elixir-ecto:postgrex. The frozen ecto v2.2.0 adapter only forwards to Postgrex.stream/4 (lib/ecto/adapters/postgres/connection.ex:112-113) and never constructs a :comment option — the only comment handling in the adapter is DDL COMMENT ON with single_quote escaping (:687-692). Its optional postgrex requirement is "~> 0.13.0" (mix.exs:47), below the affected >= 0.19.3 range. The defect is in postgrex, not ecto.

notes: No promotion: the only ecto vulnerability among these candidates, CVE-2017-20166 / GHSA-2xxx-fhc8-9qvq, is already a Ground Truth row on this snapshot. GHSA-4r2f-6fm9-2qgh is its withdrawn duplicate advisory and resolves as duplicate.

The three 2026 advisories were filed in the elixir-ecto/ecto repository but name package postgrex. The frozen ecto tree has no Postgrex.Notifications or Postgrex.stream/4 code and requires postgrex ~> 0.13.0 (mix.exs:47), below every affected range (>= 0.16.0 or >= 0.19.3). They are out of scope for this repo.
